exposure: Women who followed the lower range of the IOM recommendations for GWG and RWG
Women who followed the IOM recommendations for GWG and RWG
Body mass index (BMI) categories: normal weight (18.5-24.9 kg/m2) and underweight (<18.5 kg/m2)
cohort: Pregnant women who gave birth between January 2008 and December 2009
finding: Normal weight women following IOM GWG/RWG recommendations had no increased LBW risk, but underweight women following the lower range of recommendations had a five-fold increased risk.
mod_finding: Women with LBW infants had an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
